note: Shared design tokens for the README SVG set (this repo) and the jakes9na site (Tailwind config). Single source of truth: colour, type and motion values here must match both.

notes.crimson: 4.61:1 on white, 4.38:1 on dark bg — use for large/bold text (>=18px) or non-text UI, not small body copy.
notes.teal_light: Light-mode teal is darkened to #107A62 (5.27:1 on white); the dark-mode teal #49D7B1 fails AA on a white background.

motion.reducedMotion: every animated SVG disables all animation under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) and has a meaningful static first frame

evidence_tags.explored: Evaluated or experimented with; not tied to a listed project
